name: android_long_press
description: Performs a long-press touch gesture at normalized coordinates (0.0 to 1.0) or physical pixels with configurable hold duration.

xRatio.description: Explicit normalized horizontal ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over x.

yRatio.description: Explicit normalized vertical ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over y.

xPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel X coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over x.

yPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel Y coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over y.
